content: No, that's incorrect. Einstein actually won the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1921, but not for his theory of relativity. He was awarded the prize for his explanation of the photoelectric effect, which was a significant contribution to the understanding of quantum mechanics. His work on relativity, including special and general relativity, while groundbreaking, was not the reason for his Nobel Prize.
